name: The New Frontier
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor!  A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle.  Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
narrative.objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, Champion? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of Darnassus - nay, all of Teldrassil - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.

The fools in Moonglade waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?

chain.subtitle: 9 quests from level 55 to 57, 30,500 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Frontier
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.

quests.name: The New Frontier
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

quests.name: Rabine Saturna
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Wasteland
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.

quests.name: The Spirits of Southwind
quests.objectiveText: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

quests.name: Hive in the Tower
quests.objectiveText: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity.

quests.name: Umber, Archivist
quests.objectiveText: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
